basics.name: Ulises Alejandro MORA QUINTANA
basics.label: Full Stack Developer / Cloud Engineer
basics.summary:
Senior Full Stack Architect (+5 years) specializing in designing high-availability distributed systems. Expert in decoupling monoliths into scalable microservices by strictly applying Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, and SOLID principles. 

Frontend Authority: I elevate engineering standards in Angular (Security with Guards/Interceptors, NgRx) and React (Composition Patterns, Performance Tuning, Redux/Zustand), prioritizing rendering optimization. 

Backend & Data Performance: I architect polyglot solutions in NestJS, .NET, and Django, resolving bottlenecks through advanced strategies such as Caching (Redis), Connection Pooling, and CQRS. I implement real-time communication with Sockets and SQL/NoSQL databases. 

Cloud & Innovation: Deployment of immutable infrastructure (Docker) on AWS (ECS, EKS) and Azure. Pioneer in integrating AI/LLM capabilities with LangChain into business workflows. I guarantee total quality with Advanced Testing suites (Cypress, Jest, xUnit).
